name: Alpenglow
source:
Growing up is hard, with credit cards, leases & bills in your name. Everything in the world seems to be looking to you for an answer.

Standing on the cusp of adulthood, you and your friends decide to take one last trip up to a luxury chalet in the mountains of your hometown - Alpine Heights. There are no responsibilities, only one rule: live life the way you want to!

There are bucket lists to check off, new experiences to try, and familiar faces to visit. This is just the beginning; you still have the entirety of winter break ahead of you! 

[From [url=https://astrqlla.itch.io/alpenglow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
成长是艰难的，信用卡、租约和账单都在你的名下。世界上的一切似乎都在向你寻求答案。

即将成年的你和你的朋友决定最后一次前往家乡阿尔卑斯山高地的豪华小屋。没有责任，只有一条规则：按照你想要的方式生活！

有许多愿望清单可供核对，有新体验可供尝试，还有熟悉的面孔可供拜访。这仅仅是开始；你还有整个寒假在等着你！
